findings.F1: In a choppy trend (60-day return between -10 % and +10 %), the coin's 30-day return lines up with its next-7-day excess return: correlation 0.43, day-clustered t 2.15 (109 non-overlapping cases on 46 days); in falling (-0.02, t -0.18, 285 cases) and rising markets (-0.01, t -0.08, 259 cases) it does not.
findings.F2: Inside the choppy trend, the link sits in the calm half, not in the agitated half that was tested: calm correlation 0.37, t 2.04 (48 cases, 22 days), agitated 0.15, t 0.67 (23 cases, 18 days). This fits the tested book's weak result (verdict t 0.74; Sharpe 0.03; trades average -9.7 % on ZEC over 39 trades and -4.8 % on XMR over 37). Agitation here is read as a 90-bar rank of the 30-day swing, because a window holds about 122 bars.
findings.F3: The choppy-market effect is graded and works both ways: the excess 7-day return by 30-day-return quintile is -11.2 %, -4.0 %, +0.9 %, +4.1 % and +7.3 % (about 22 cases each). In choppy calm, a negative month is followed by -5.9 % (t -1.68, 21 cases) and a positive month by +9.2 % (t 1.48, 27 cases).
findings.F4: The choppy-market link is spread across coins and years, not driven by one: the correlation is positive on all 10 coins (0.14 to 0.92; ZEC t 2.61, LTC t 1.95). It is positive in 2019 (0.16, t 0.84), 2020 (0.77, t 1.29) and 2021 (0.49, t 2.92), and slightly negative only in 2018 (-0.09, 10 cases).
findings.F5: In a choppy market the signal comes from the recent weeks. The 14-day return carries the same link (correlation 0.41, t 1.92). The older month (days 31 to 60) points the other way (correlation -0.45, t -1.91), as it must when the 60-day return is flat.
findings.F6: Other angles show nothing that stands out after this many looks:

ideas.idea: In a choppy, calm market, the further a coin's close sits above its close of 30 days earlier, as a percent of that earlier close, the more it rises over the next 7 days, and the further it sits below, the more it falls.
ideas.consequence: A trader follows a coin's past month, long after a rise and short after a fall, sized by the month's move, only while its two-month trend is flat and its swing is at or below its usual level, and refuses the same trade in agitated choppy markets.
ideas.name: calm choppy month continuation
